slug: 2024-09-06 Libya's Project Intilaqa matches Civil Registry electronic data with paper records

systems.owner: Civil Registry Authority (CRA), Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: 257 offices had completed matching and scanning by September 2024, with the data of 1.8 million families printed, a 97% completion rate on the CRA's figure

note: Intilaqa matches the Civil Registry's electronic data against paper records and scans them, which is back-capture and checking of registers already written; the article does not say how a new birth or death is entered, so the sub-indicator takes no fact.
